tenderSchedule.description:
Out Sourcing of vehicles along with Drivers
One year

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Providing service letter for at least one year for Government offices

Dated 01-01-2022 onwards registred A/C vehcile (as per Tender document) R.C Book, Insurance Documents, Tax paid Details of Ownership of Vehicles, Emission test copy, Driver Licence with photo, Authroized PSV Badge certificate
Yellow board registration copy of vehicles provided for service
Travel Registration Certificate copy issued by Transport or Tourism Department
Vehicle provided B extract (obtained from RTO) copy
The bidder should submit a valid Trade license copy obtained from the local bodies (from Competent Authority/ Municipality/ Town Panchayat/ BBMP etc.)
Submission of Declaration as per Annexure-3 of Tender document along with signature of the bIdder
The bidder should submit a notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- for non-blacklisting in Government and other organizations.
Provide GST registration certificate and copies of GST clearance certificate for the year 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 till June-2026.
Annual turn over certificate & Balance sheet attested by CA for any 3 years (Financial Year: 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Provide Pan card copy and Income tax returns details of any 3 years (Financial Year: 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 or 2025-26)
Bidders offering vehicles of other ownership shall attach a copy of the agreement with the original owner of service provided cars.
